Rahul Gandhi Criticizes Delimitation Bill, Calls Support Betrayal

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has strongly criticized the Delimitation Bill, stating that any party supporting it would be betraying the people of Tamil Nadu. He made these remarks while meeting families of NEET aspirants who died by suicide, suggesting these students were failed by a dishonest system. Gandhi urged opposition parties to unite and thwart the bill's passage.
